case_number: 2025 INSC 70; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 13422 OF 2024; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 13423 OF 2024
summary: Promotion eligibility dispute; Associate Professor post; M.Ch degree requirement; interpretation of Government Order 07.04.2008 vs 14.12.2009; physical teaching experience criteria; postgraduate degree acquisition timeline; KS and SSR Rules 10 and 28 applicability; High Court interference improper; promotion based on superseded GO upheld; select list validity confirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Kerala State and Subordinate Services Rules, 1958 Part II Rules 10, 28
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; promotion of Dr. Sharmad to Associate Professor restored; review Departmental Promotion Committee meeting quashed.
